Thanks for the loop. Quick technical checklist that maps to what our security ops needs to validate the pilot before credit release:

1) Attestation / report:
   - SOC 2 Type II summary or equivalent. If full report is not shareable, a redacted summary with control mappings is fine.
2) Scope diagram:
   - Data flow diagram showing which systems will send PHI (if any) to the pilot, network boundaries, and any egress points.
3) KMS/BYOK details:
   - Are you bringing your own keys or using Redwood-managed keys for pilot? If BYOK, include KMS ARN and contact for key rotation.
4) Retention + deletion plan:
   - Retention windows for pilot data, deletion procedure, contact for data removal.
5) Test account & sample data description:
   - Indicate whether you will use synthetic data or redacted production samples.

I’ve attached a short internal checklist that we use to validate Private Network pilots: redwood-vpc-checklist.pdf (attached). If you can drop the items into the Drive folder (link below) we’ll start the validation. Security usually turns around checks within 48 hours for straightforward cases.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example

—Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
